reason: The posted daily cleaning log, shoes off and capped numbers speak to my biggest worry, and a gated Baby Nook for my 10-month-old plus a seat for me is rare around here. The free first visit means I can check it myself before spending anything.
objection: I'll believe it's clean when I see it. A log is just paper, and my baby chews on everything. If the toys look grimy or it's crowded, I won't be back.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it clean in person on the free visit, with the Baby Nook truly separate from the bigger kids and toys visibly wiped down between uses.
